title: Game Awards 2026: the six Game of the Year nominees
description: The Game Awards 2026 nominees are out. Here are the six Game of the Year contenders and when the show airs.

scenes.say: The Game Awards nominees are out, and the Game of the Year race has just six names. Here they are.
The nominees are: double oh seven First Light, Control Resonant, Grand Theft Auto Six, Ocarina of Time, Phantom Blade Zero, and Resident Evil Requiem.
The ceremony is set for December tenth, live from the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

It's an unusual list. A game with 1998 roots sits beside one that launched this month, so two eras are competing for one trophy. Which one feels like the winner to you? Say it in the comments, and follow for more awards coverage.
